title: Backlash over the 2021 transients paper co-authored with Jeff Marcy

tellings.quote: in 2021 uh when we did this discovery of the nine transients uh I published a paper with my colleague Jeff Marcy. So he had been uh cancelled in a uh sexual harassment scandal in 2015.

plain: The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel says that in 2021 she published her discovery of nine transients, points of light in old sky photographs that appear and then vanish, with her colleague Jeff Marcy, an astronomer who she says had been cancelled in a sexual harassment scandal in 2015. She tells it first-hand, as the reason her work met a backlash from other astronomers.
